market.definition: Water-line performance additives (heat, gut, respiratory, vitamins) bought for commercial broilers in Southeast Vietnam, valued at farm-gate sell-out.
market.baseline_method: New market: no sales, no listing, so the no-spend baseline is zero.
market.sizing: ≈140M broiler placements/yr in the Southeast × €30 water-line spend per 1,000 birds = €4.2M. Broiler placements derived from VPA day-old-chick output (530–550M from members = 65–70% of total) with a 60% broiler share and a 30% Southeast share.

promotion.spend_logic: Launch: ESOV of +6 points is affordable because category media is thin (trade press, Zalo, events).

assumptions.item: 60% of chicks are broilers; Southeast holds 30% of broilers → ≈140M placements/yr
Water-line additive spend €30 per 1,000 broilers across all products
Sell-out price €12 per 1,000 birds; importer + đại lý margin 35%
XVET gross margin 55% of net → 36% of sell-out
